sentences.text: Aalto Guard Oy is a newly registered company, entered in the register on 2026-09-06 under the industry code 62100, computer programming activities.
First sales are recorded on 2026-09-06, and a start-up notification and a board change were registered on 2026-09-16.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the name contains a word that can mean waves in Finnish, but the record does not show what the software does.
